name: authoring-transform-locale-free-identifier-blocked
description: Sandbox globals contract before save: a JavaScript transform that formats a date with toLocaleDateString and returns an undeclared identifier (actionData) parses as a function body but cannot run in the sandbox. validate_draft refuses it with findings on the transform's expression path that name the locale API with the sk.* replacement and the undeclared identifier, and edit_workflow_patch refuses to introduce it, leaving the draft unchanged. The same transform written against sk.fmt passes both.
failure_class: transform with Intl or undeclared identifiers saved and failing at runtime

steps.expression:
const rows = input.scope.list_items.data.items ?? [];
return rows.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, total: sk.fmt.number(r.total, { locale: 'de', digits: 2 }) }));
